newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady, trade thin after reference rate.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady, trade thin after reference rate.

text.p: Thai baht traded in a narrow range on Friday in very thin trade after the Bank of Thailand set a slightly lower baht/dollar reference rate than on Thursday, dealers said.
"The (baht/dollar) trade is around yesterday's level. There is still not much movement in the market today," said one dealer at a local bank.

In the domestic market, the baht was traded at around 28.20/28.70 per dollar at 0157 GMT compared with 28.00/29.00 before the announcement of the reference rate. The baht was quoted at 28.25/28.65 near the close on Thursday.
The Bank of Thailand announced the reference rate, which is the average of interbank trade from the previous day, of 28.189 per dollar compared with 27.383 on Thursday.
In the offshore market, the baht was traded at 28.650/28.800 compared with 28.60/28.80 before the reference rate. The baht was quoted at 29.00/29.50 in offshore market near the close on Thursday.
"The baht went slightly lower (after the annoucement of reference rate). But I don't think the market really looks at the reference rate at all in the offshore market," said one dealer in Singapore.
Dealers said the market is still taking time to digest the new floating baht foreign exchange system, while the continuing two-tiered market also limited the baht trading.
